mapper.sql: o.orderId,o.orderDate,o.userId,o.hpId,o.smId,o.state,o.patientType,COALESCE(o.patientName,u.realName) AS realName,COALESCE(o.patientSex,u.sex) AS sex,u.realName AS bookingName,h.name AS hospitalName,s.name AS setmealName
FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.userId=o.userId JOIN hospital h ON h.hpId=o.hpId JOIN setmeal s ON s.smId=o.smId
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.userId=o.userId
SELECT ORDER BY o.orderDate DESC,o.orderId DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT , COALESCE(o.patientIdentityCard,u.identityCard) AS patientIdentityCard, COALESCE(o.patientBirthday,u.birthday) AS patientBirthday WHERE o.orderId=#{orderId} AND o.paymentStatus='PAID'
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET state=#{state} WHERE orderId=#{orderId} AND state = 1 AND #{state} = 2
